noun_definition: Request money refers to a feature in the application that allows users to initiate a transaction to request a specific amount of money from another user.
Gap refers to the space between the error messages and the 'Next' button on the Request Money's Manual Page, which is noted to be larger than on other pages.
error message refers to the notification displayed to the user when an invalid amount is entered in the Request Money feature, which should have a consistent gap compared to other pages.

next button refers to the user interface element that is clicked after entering an amount in the Request Money feature, which is expected to have a consistent gap from error messages compared to other pages.

Request money's manual page refers to the specific section of the application where users can request money and view related information, which is being compared to other pages in terms of the layout of error messages.
